Multiple Vulnerabilities in Mitel MiCollab Could Allow for Arbitrary Code Execution
item.description: Multiple vulnerabilities have been discovered in Mitel MiCollab, the most severe of which could allow for arbitrary code execution. Mitel MiCollab is a unified communications and collaboration platform that combines voice, video, chat, conferencing, and mobility features for enterprise users. Successful exploitation of the most severe of these vulnerabilities could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the system. item.title: A Vulnerability in VMware Products Could Allow for Authentication Bypass
item.description: A vulnerability has been discovered in VMware vCenter, which could allow for authentication bypass. VMware vCenter Server is a centralized management platform used to administer VMware vSphere environments, including ESXi hosts and the virtual machines running on them. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.
